# The Punjab Edit

> The Punjab Edit is an independent editorial journal covering sport, fitness, everyday lifestyle and useful local stories across Chandigarh, Patiala and Nabha, Punjab, India.

## About
The site publishes practical, original articles intended to help readers explore local places, build sustainable habits and discover useful ideas. Articles should be read in their full context; local details can change and should be independently verified before acting on them.

## Main sections
- Sport & Outdoors
- Fitness
- Health & Lifestyle
- Lifestyle & Local

## Editorial principles
- Prefer original reporting, firsthand experience and clearly attributed sources.
- Verify local business details, event dates, prices and opening hours before publication.
- Clearly disclose sponsorships, affiliate relationships and other material connections.
- Correct factual errors and update articles when important information changes.
- Do not treat general fitness or wellness articles as individual medical advice.
